add.name: using-superpowers
add.purpose: Bootstrap skill for the Superpowers plugin: establishes that the agent must look for and invoke relevant skills before any response, and how to find them.
add.how_to_use: Loaded at session start by the Superpowers plugin; the entry point that makes the other superpowers skills (brainstorming, writing-plans, etc.) fire reliably.
add.evidence: obra/superpowers 294k stars; skills.sh 258k installs; mcpservers.org listed; known gap
add.notes: Most useful alongside the rest of Superpowers; subagents are told to ignore it.

add.name: grilling
add.purpose: The actual interview engine behind grill-me: maps a plan as a design tree and asks the user frontier questions in numbered rounds with recommended answers until shared understanding.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'grill me' and similar; grill-me and grill-with-docs are thin wrappers that call this skill, so install it alongside them.
add.notes: Existing entry grill-me (7 lines) just calls 'grilling'; without this skill grill-me does nothing.

add.name: handoff
add.purpose: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document so a fresh agent session can pick up the work without losing context.
add.how_to_use: Invoke manually (/handoff, model-invocation disabled) with what the next session is for; writes to the OS temp dir. Sibling claude-handoff launches a background agent instead.
add.notes: Short SKILL.md (16 lines) but complete; manual-only.
